findings.evidence: The I6 workflow previously contained duplicate job IDs and GitHub rejected workflow execution before jobs were created.
findings.correction: Canonical workflow reduced to unique job IDs before operational closure rerun.

findings.evidence: Preview deploy log emitted fatal: not a git repository because git grep ran after cd into the packaged bundle.
findings.risk: A referenced Preview channel could be misclassified as unreferenced.
findings.correction: All Preview channel reference checks now run git -C $GITHUB_WORKSPACE grep against the versioned repository.

findings.evidence: Operational proof returned NO_MANAGER while previous authenticated hydration evidence had a verified Dirección/SuperAdmin actor.
findings.cause: Proof role extractor omitted rolesDisponibles/activeRole surfaces.
findings.correction: Proof actor discovery now recognizes the same canonical membership role surfaces used by product/runtime evidence while retaining disabled=false and emailVerified=true requirements.
findings.followup: Current tenant has no selectable emailVerified manager for CI proof. Runtime proof may use an active non-disabled manager via Firebase custom token only; public login remains independently fail-closed on emailVerified=true.

invariants: No LIVE promotion after failed Preview proof.
Same immutable artifact is promoted Preview to LIVE.
Rollback candidate remains bound before promotion.
No hardcoded Samuel/Carlos/Paula identity is used by product or proof selection.
Operational proof selects an eligible verified manager by membership data, not by name/email.
Preview channel reuse is allowed only when the channel ID is not referenced anywhere in the versioned repository.
Data mutation remains forbidden for this code-only operational closure candidate.
I6.5 receipt/portfolio deterministic writes are not repeated.
CI custom-token proof may select an active non-disabled manager even if email is unverified only to exercise runtime; it must never alter the product login requirement or claim email verification.
Public login source contract must continue to reject rawUser.emailVerified!==true and ACCOUNT_NOT_READY.
